prompt.final:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Asset type: MythCanvas Norse M01 collectible-card source artwork.

Create ONE standalone landscape 16:9 pure artwork for card 1003010049, Norse Genesis / 北欧创世, type ensemble.

This is an original mythological interpretation, not a copy of a modern franchise design.

The image must contain no typography, title, logo, card frame, number, watermark, pseudo-runes, UI, collage, split layout, contact sheet, or panels.

Content brief: horizontal series cover, Ymir as the single dominant subject in Ginnungagap, simple cold-vs-warm environmental masses, painterly negative space, no galaxy or debris overload.

Visual thesis: 尤弥尔是唯一主要角色，冰火两极只做大面积低细节背景。

Visual continuity entities: ymir；audumbla；buri.

Canonical image references required for identity/landmark matching: 1003010001；1003010002；1003010003. These references control recurring face, age, silhouette, palette, material, and landmark geometry; they do not control camera or pose.

Source-bound continuity facts: audumbla: Primeval cow whose milk feeds Ymir.；audumbla: She reveals Búri by licking salty rime.；buri: Revealed from salty rime over three days by Auðumbla's licking.；buri: Described as fair in appearance, great, and mighty.

MythCanvas locked continuity design: ymir: Colossal pre-world humanoid with dark frost-stone skin, massive brow and nose, deep-set pale eyes, and long frost-white hair and beard.；ymir: Ancient and elemental rather than a normal Viking warrior; no armor, helmet, weapons, or tailored costume.；ymir: Maintain the same facial bone structure, hairline, beard shape, and relative scale in every appearance.；audumbla: Colossal shaggy pale primeval cow, visibly larger and more ancient than ordinary cattle.；audumbla: Use the same wide sweeping horn silhouette, heavy forehead, dark nose, long winter coat, and monumental shoulder mass.；audumbla: Never substitute a smooth modern dairy cow or reduce her to ordinary livestock scale.；audumbla: Four milk streams must read as four clean mythic rivulets without anatomical grotesqueness.；buri: Handsome, powerful early-god adult in his apparent thirties, not an elderly patriarch.；buri: Pale wheat-blond shoulder-length hair, short neat beard, strong straight nose, clear gray-blue eyes, broad shoulders, and natural warm human skin.；buri: Simple frost-wet pale drapery only; no crown, armor, runes, weapon, or giant traits.；buri: Card 1003010003 is the face, age, hair, beard, and body-proportion reference.

Identity anchors: 无额外条目

Must keep: 无额外条目

Must avoid: 无额外条目

Composition: camera clear subject-first camera; shot single readable composition; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Series-wide visual grammar: keep matte painterly surfaces；broad readable forms；limited focal sharpness；quiet atmospheric negative space；restrained blue-white frost and ember light；subject detail clearly stronger than background detail; avoid glossy game-CG rendering；hyper-detailed-everything；generic Viking cosplay；floating realm platforms；science-fiction orbit graphics；random glowing runes；multiple competing focal centers.

Color and material guidance: palette 无额外条目; materials 无额外条目; mood 无额外条目.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010001. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: typography；logo；card frame；watermark；formed world landscape；galaxy wallpaper；debris overload；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete landscape 16:9 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 2880x1620 pixels.
